```{r, include=FALSE}
library(edgeR)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(openxlsx)
library(SpatialExperiment)
library(SingleCellExperiment)
```

```{r}
bin16_list_ann <- readRDS("~/bin16_list_ann_gfp.rds")

treated_samples <- bin16_list_ann[names(bin16_list_ann) %in% c("c26murf1_b2", "c26murf1_b3", "c26murf1_b5", "c26murf1_b9", "c26foxO_b1","c26foxO_b4","c26foxO_b6","c26foxO_b9", "c26SMAD23_b2","c26SMAD23_b4","c26SMAD23_b5","c26SMAD23_b9")]

treated_samples$c26murf1_b2$in_treatment <- ifelse(treated_samples$c26murf1_b2$in_treatment == TRUE, 1, 0)
treated_samples$c26SMAD23_b2$in_treatment <- ifelse(treated_samples$c26SMAD23_b2$in_treatment == TRUE, 1, 0)

cell_types <- c("Myonuclei_IIb", "Myonuclei_IIx",
                     "Myonuclei_IIx_IIa", "Myonuclei_IIx_IIb",
                     "Myonuclei_MTJ", "Myonuclei_NMJ", "Myonuclei_Trim63")

```

```{r}
treated_samples <- lapply(treated_samples, function(spe) {
  spe$in_treatment <- ifelse(spe$in_treatment == 1, "gfp+", "untreated")
  spe <- spe[, spe$new_cell_type %in% cell_types]
  return(spe)
})
```

#function for edgeR analysis
```{r}
run_edgeR_pipeline <- function(spe, sample_name, output_dir = "./") {
  cat("\n--- Processing Sample:", sample_name, "---\n")
  
  y <- DGEList(counts = counts(spe), samples = as.data.frame(colData(spe)))
  keep <- rowSums(counts(spe) > 0) > 1000
  if (sum(keep) == 0) {
    warning(paste("No genes passed filtering for sample", sample_name))
    return(NULL)
  }
  y <- y[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
  y <- calcNormFactors(y)
  y$samples$in_treatment <- as.factor(y$samples$in_treatment)
  y$samples$in_treatment <- relevel(y$samples$in_treatment, ref = "untreated")
  design <- model.matrix(~ in_treatment, data = y$samples)
  y <- estimateDisp(y, design)
  fit <- glmFit(y, design)
  lrt <- glmLRT(fit, coef = "in_treatmentgfp+")

  res <- topTags(lrt, n = Inf)$table
  res$SYMBOL <- rownames(res)
  res$significant <- res$FDR < 0.05
  
  sig <- res[res$significant, ]
  sig_up <- sig[sig$logFC >= 0, ]
  sig_down <- sig[sig$logFC < 0, ]
  
  gene_summary <- data.frame(
    Geni_considerati = nrow(res),
    Geni_significativi = nrow(sig),
    Upregolati = nrow(sig_up),
    Downregolati = nrow(sig_down)
  )
  print(gene_summary)

  output_file <- file.path(output_dir, paste0("edgeR_results_", sample_name, ".xlsx"))
  wb <- createWorkbook()
  addWorksheet(wb, "Tutti_geni")
  writeData(wb, "Tutti_geni", res, rowNames = TRUE)
  addWorksheet(wb, "Significativi")
  writeData(wb, "Significativi", sig, rowNames = TRUE)
  addWorksheet(wb, "Upregolati")
  writeData(wb, "Upregolati", sig_up, rowNames = TRUE)
  addWorksheet(wb, "Downregolati")
  writeData(wb, "Downregolati", sig_down, rowNames = TRUE)
  saveWorkbook(wb, output_file, overwrite = TRUE)
  cat("Results saved to:", output_file, "\n")
  
  return(res)
}

```

```{r}
results_list <- iwalk(treated_samples, ~ run_edgeR_pipeline(spe = .x, sample_name = .y))
```
